# Native method-call support-order diagnostic

Pass the caller's existing leading can-call assumption into the common declared
preparation helper, as exit checks already do. Move the same support object only
when the existing complete-fragment certificate proves noninterference; retain
original order otherwise. All caller support is retained exactly once, with all
actual check expressions, guards, fuel and assertion attributes compared against
the unchanged native control. Source, state, scope and post-check publication are
unchanged. False-entry controls must be genuinely Invalid.

Selected names bound only this regression diagnostic. Normal product workflows
do not enable it, and it supplies no whole-suite or product acceptance.
